messages:
lexi (DevEx): Hey team :wave: Opening a small PR to refresh the Quickstart 'hello-convo' tutorial — replacing cURL examples with fetch, adding ephemeral key local-dev flow, and a tiny WebSocket section for realtime. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345

mike (Eng): Heads up — runtime param rename: `max_output_tokens` -> `max_tokens`. Also streaming endpoint path changed from `/v1/stream` -> `/v1/responses/stream`. Snippets need both updates.

sara (Docs): Got it. I'll swap the param and update the JS/TS snippets. For fetch examples, do we keep the minimal cookie-less flow or show a small server-proxy example? Also need a short CORS note for Private deployments.

todd (PM): Can we add a short blurb under "Before you begin" clarifying examples assume Hosted API by default, and point to Dedicated/Private sections for config differences?

lexi (DevEx): Yes — add a one-line callout for Dedicated vs Hosted. Also noticed the sample repo Dockerfile uses `node:14`; we should bump it.

alex (Eng): I can check the Dockerfile. Recommend `node:18-alpine`. Also the sample env var in the repo is `REDWOOD_API_KEY` — for local ephemeral dev please use `REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN`.

sara (Docs): I'll include a small inline fetch snippet showing the ephemeral flow and mention the env var. Example to paste into README:

```js
// local dev with ephemeral token in env
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN}`
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'Hello world' })
})
```

mike (Eng): Also update TS SDK call — method name changed: `redwood.responses.create` -> `redwood.responses.generate`. Tiny change but will break copy/paste.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview ready: netlify/netlify-preview/hello-refresh — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-12345.netlify.app :rocket:

lexi (DevEx): Preview looks good except there's a broken link on the "Deploy to Dedicated" callout -> 404. It currently points to `/docs/dedicated/setup-old`. Needs to go to `/docs/dedicated/getting-started`.

sara (Docs): Thanks — I pushed a follow-up in PR 12346 to fix that link and added a short KMS note under the first-deploy checklist for Private customers.

todd (PM): LGTM from product. Anyone object to merging after quick runtime check from Mike and Alex?

mike (Eng): I'll run the updated snippets against the runtime locally by EOD and report back.

alex (Eng): Pushed Dockerfile tweak (`node:18-alpine`) and updated README env var. CI passed.

sara (Docs): :thumbsup: I'll hold the merge until Mike confirms the runtime checks.

mike (Eng): All green on my side. Verified fetch + TS SDK + streaming path. No regressions. Merge away.

lexi (DevEx): Great — merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! :tada:
